detailed_rationale:
Aurionpro Solutions is a banking-technology and fintech platform provider (Banking & Fintech ~56% of 9M FY26 revenue, growing 25.5% YoY -- transaction banking, treasury and lending platforms such as iCashpro+, SmartLender, and the AuroPay payments offering) with a genuinely strong historical growth record: 5-year sales CAGR ~30%, 5-year profit CAGR ~34%, on an almost debt-free balance sheet (D/E 0.035, interest coverage ~28x). The quant sheet's growth_3y_score of 83.7 (among the highest in this cohort) reflects this real multi-year compounding.

The latest quarter (Q1 FY27) shows clear deceleration versus the historical average -- TTM sales growth of ~15% and profit growth of only ~8%, versus the 28-34% five-year CAGRs -- so extrapolating the trailing 3-year figure into a forward estimate would overstate the current trajectory. Aurionpro has also grown historically in part through acquisitions in the fintech/banking-platform space, which is worth flagging as a caveat on how much of the headline CAGR is organic versus consolidation-driven, though I found no evidence of a specific recent distorting deal. A separate governance-adjacent watch item: promoter holding has declined to 26.9% (down ~4.3 points over three years) -- not itself a red flag (could reflect regulatory float requirements or routine secondary sales) but worth monitoring rather than dismissing.

At a live P/E in the ~19-22x range against a still-respectable mid-teens growth outlook and ROE/ROCE in the mid-teens, valuation looks reasonable rather than demanding. Quality score in the quant sheet (25.7) looks low relative to what the live fundamentals show, likely reflecting factors (e.g., promoter-holding trend, or M&A/goodwill composition) not fully visible in this research pass, but nothing found here would push this toward a Sell case.
recommendation_rationale: Quant composite is Hold (45.7/3yr). Fundamentals are consistent with an unchanged Hold: real, if decelerating, growth on a clean balance sheet at a reasonable multiple. No basis to escalate -- the promoter-stake decline is a watch item, not evidence of distress, and nothing else rises to the escalation bar.
summary: Aurionpro is a fintech/banking-technology platform provider with a strong multi-year growth record and a clean, low-debt balance sheet, though growth has clearly slowed from its historical pace in the most recent quarter. At a reasonable valuation for that moderated growth rate, we rate it a hold.
positive_para: A genuine multi-year growth track record (5yr sales CAGR ~30%, profit CAGR ~34%) built on a growing banking/fintech platform business (56% of revenue, still growing ~25% YoY in that segment), on an almost debt-free balance sheet (D/E 0.035) at a reasonable ~19-22x earnings multiple for the demonstrated growth and mid-teens ROE/ROCE.
negative_para: Growth has decelerated meaningfully from the historical 28-34% CAGR to roughly 15% TTM sales / 8% TTM profit growth, so the trailing multi-year CAGR should not be extrapolated forward. Promoter holding has declined to 26.9% (down ~4.3 points over three years) -- a governance-adjacent item worth monitoring even though it is not confirmed as a distress signal, and part of the historical growth record likely reflects the company's acquisitive history in the banking-platform space rather than purely organic expansion.
reverse_dcf_judgment: At ~19-22x earnings for a business now growing profit at a high-single-digit to mid-teens rate (having decelerated from 28-34% five-year CAGRs) with ROE/ROCE in the mid-teens, the multiple looks reasonable rather than demanding -- not a bargain, but not pricing in unrealistic re-acceleration either.
